title: Aromatic Peruvian Shrimp Tiradito
description: A briny and springy weeknight Peruvian dish featuring panang curry paste, this diabetic-friendly recipe is perfect for a quick dinner, served in a raclette grill vessel as a tiradito.
instructions: Preheat the raclette grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together panang curry paste, lime juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the curry mixture.
Thread the shrimp onto skewers, if desired, and place on the raclette grill.
Cook the shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side, or until pink and cooked through.
Transfer the cooked shrimp to a plate and garnish with chopped cilantro.
Serve immediately, with additional lime wedges on the side if desired.
Garnish with additional cilantro, if desired.
